reviews.title: Ice cream come constantly
reviews.text: I can’t read a full article from any news source without getting the ice cream cone graphic that Google news failed. Very annoying. Deleting and reinstalling didn’t change the frequency of it happening. Like 1 in 3 things I click on ends up failing. Deleted app and not going back.

reviews.title: GN stories always crash - Get AP News instead
reviews.text: Terrible app.  GN always crashes out for no reason on iPhone.  Stories are also riddled with horrible embedded ads.  It’s a glorified browser that aggregates other content.  GN doesn’t own any of the content so the stories are unreadable.  It pretty much sucks.  Recommend getting the AP News app instead.  It is well done and has been rock solid for me.

reviews.title: Just an ad app
reviews.text: Deleted it. It’s just an app pushing ads for literally every pay wall. Typical Google

reviews.title: Articles require subscription Most articles require paid access.
reviews.text: Most articles require paid access. Such a waste.

reviews.title: Get a handle on bad actors
reviews.text: Half the outlets have figured out ways to freeze navigation with their pay/signup walls, forcing the user to kill the app and reload it to get away from them. Google should be ashamed of tolerating this behavior in their apps, either prevent it or ban the outlets who do it

reviews.title: Pages break so often
reviews.text: This app could be great but news pages constantly break and become unreadable. Either the page completely crashes or it freezes and can no longer be scrolled! This makes the app pointless as you can’t actually read the news!

reviews.title: Not working since the last Apple update
reviews.text:
There is literally nothing in my newsfeed. Zero. Zilch. And in my following? Not much there either. There seems to be a real glitch in this app now. It's not usable.

It’s several weeks later now and it’s doing the same thing. There’s nothing at all in the content

reviews.title: Notification issue!
reviews.text: Your notifications only send when I open and refresh the app! PLEASE FIX ASAP!

reviews.title: Terribly
reviews.text: too much advertising

reviews.title: Awful
reviews.text:
No option to hide “types of stories”, not news sources. E.g. I’m tired of seeing stories like “someone got stabbed, killed, murdered”. Or the clickbait politics articles. Unless this is everything newsworthy what’s happening in the UK right now.

Update several (many) years later: 
Nothing changed. What’s even worse - there’s been an earthquake in Panama and for some reason Google news doesn’t seem to care to pick this up. Speechless… 

Just observing the type of aggregated news over the years one would think there’s a intentional algorithm which forces specific type of news to be displayed and certain information to remain hidden.

reviews.title: Nearly every article is paywalled
reviews.text:
I guess one might find nice to be able to see all the headlines in one place but for me it is useless if you can’t read the articles even for publications I subscribed to. 

You are better off skipping this app and just reading the full articles directly from the publisher rather than just the headlines here

reviews.text: I’ve tried instructing the app repeatedly that I don’t want sports - I’ve told it to stop showing ESPN and other sports news outlets, I’ve told it to show me more of other things and less sports… but notifications continue to be dominated by sports coverage. I’ve turned off notifications and may also delete the app.

reviews.title: Clickbait trash
reviews.text:
The majority of the articles are clickbait behind paywalls.  The app regularly freezes and they allow some of the articles to basically highjack your phone where you can’t back out from the paywall you hit.  You have to close the app entirely and then start over.  Also there’s no sort of popup blocking and I have had volume issues when I was in a quiet place and it suddenly plays some advertisements.  

I get it that it’s all about money but damn this app

reviews.text: There needs to be audio on the apps so if you have a vision problem, you can hear it versus reading every It’s not a problem, but it should have audio built-in These app apps do not have audio built-in if someone can direct me to it I will be grateful

reviews.title: Locks up
reviews.text: I had to delete this app. After clicking on a New York Times article it locked up and kept trying to force me to enter my email and sign in to Google which I didn’t want to do. No back arrow or way to close the window. I think their only goal is to collect meta-data from you. Which I understand but when they decide to force it on you, that’s where I draw the line. Do not instal this app.

reviews.title: No option to remove pay walled source
reviews.text: When it comes to social media and news there is apparently no money in allowing users to choose their own content and instead they choose deliver a never-ending stream of curated content. Google News doubles down on this and no longer allows  me to remove pay walled sites or sources that I don’t like. The lack of control and choice is intentional and never going away.

reviews.title: now forces X to be in a news source
reviews.text: No matter how you try. No matter how hard you look. No matter what you do. You can never get rid of X as a new source. It appears to be the only required new source for Google News and X gets to report, unverified, bogus, untruthful, rumors as legitimate news. Shame on Google. Shame on Google. Shame on Google.

reviews.text:
No really, thumbs down is the problem with this app. No matter how many times I click “suggest less” it keeps feeding me rugby, cricket, tennis and MMA stories. The algorithm appears to be impossible to train, rendering thr app useless.

Uninstalling after 1 day of frustration.

reviews.title: Not current; not news
reviews.text: Wikipedia is more current than Google News. I’m tired of a news feed that shows articles from days or weeks ago. C’mon Google!

reviews.title: Terrible App

reviews.title: Very Buggy
reviews.text: The app seems to have some pretty major bugs. I regularly will have the article I’m reading disappear half way through due to an unexpected error.

reviews.title: Spoilers Galore

It's like there is literally no filter over what notifications are allowed to be sent. So now i have to disable having the entire concept of news notify my of anything from my phone because google can't just allow you to not spoil things.....there is no setting to turn that off. This app is trash and old.

reviews.title: Far left ad filled crash-app
reviews.text:
I don’t mind left, right and center articles, but this app pushes the far left agenda. Go figure. 90% of the news stories require a subscription to each and every different news outlet. 
With all of the trackers on top of that, I’m deleting this app. Garbage.

reviews.title: Least reliable app on iPhone
reviews.text: If you like being disappointed on a daily basis, this is the app for you. Clearly very little Google investment going on here otherwise the “There was an error displaying this content” problem would have been fixed years ago. Great at organizing all the world’s information; not so great at showing it.

reviews.title: A Very Google Product
reviews.text: I spent more time closing ads in the news stories than actually reading them.

reviews.title: Very limited
reviews.text: The world news section is an embarrassment. Maybe 10 articles at most, that’s it. Other sections may have twice as much, but as far as world news goes, it’s a joke. This is Google, not a myopic high school news paper

reviews.title: So many pop-ups that it’s not even worth using
reviews.text: Between the paywalls on about 50 percent of the articles, and the multiple pop-ups that you keep closing, but keep popping back up again that prevents you from reading the articles it’s not even worth using.

reviews.title: Crashes randomly/Screen goes black
reviews.text:
It crashes all the time. You’ll be reading an article, scroll down to read more, start reading, then BOOM! The screen suddenly goes black with an error message and you have to reload the page from the beginning. It’s happens randomly every time I use the app. Like a mine that randomly explodes.

The only way to stop it is to copy the link into safari and read it there where it doesn’t crash.

Please fix the regular web page crashing.

reviews.title: So many ads
reviews.text: This platform seems to pick the articles with the most ads.  Why does every news place suck now or sell your info?  Please clean up your shhhh or be deleted like the rest.

reviews.title: Used to be mehOK now it’s a joke
reviews.text: It should be called gaslighting news. I have to go to actual trustworthy news websites, ABC or NBC or BBC even Al Jazeera is more reliable than gaslighting news. What do you expect from a company that decided to rename THE GULF OF MEXICO.

reviews.title: App is not better than website
reviews.text: The Google News app is nowhere near as good as just using the website in a browser. The settings don’t properly control autoplay videos, and the app constantly hangs while scrolling — then suddenly a video blasts on screen. Even worse, most story links don’t return back to the app correctly, so you end up having to completely close the app just to get back to the home page. Frustrating experience overall and I would not recommend using the app.

reviews.title: Not a good app
reviews.text: Most news articles require a subscription to read them. This is a mostly worthless app. I tried it and deleted it soon thereafter.

reviews.title: Cluttered with ads
reviews.text:
I get that ads are necessary, but I’m tired of seeing the majority of my articles fill with so many ads that it heats up my phone and crashes the app 20% of the time. 

15 Pro Max.

reviews.title: CONSTANT error message with ‘ice cream’ image
reviews.text: I cannot read more than a paragraph of any article before the screen goes to the ‘ice cream’ error message stating that the content cannot be displayed. It’s infuriating and every single time I use the app.

reviews.title: Bugs aglore
reviews.text:
For the internets major search engine you’d expect their news app to return precision results. But the search feature throws up random results when searching key terms like city name or subject.  you’d expect to see local and relevant stories but it chooses its own subcategory and brings up sport or events. It’s not wholly reliable in delivering the latest news and there’s no option to filter out paywalled news outlets. 

The other major bug is with the navigation, opening stories unintentionally as you scroll. 

I don’t find it the most user friendly experience. I also find that it has its own bias and filter that breaks impartiality values. I wouldn’t rely on Google news to deliver you the whole story since it’s driven by algorithms and I know for a fact that there is much more local and regional news that they are not presenting.

reviews.title: Not what it used to be
reviews.text: No dark or text size adjustment means getting blasted when reading at night.  Lots of ads and paywalls.  Government announcements (political propaganda) presented as legitimate news.

reviews.title: Ads Everywhere!
reviews.text: It's basically 90% ads and 10% news articles now. Can't even read an article anymore because of the high amount of ads. Ridiculous! 👎

reviews.title: Too Many Distractions
reviews.text:
Waaayyy too many adds and other distractions that makes reading news nearly impossible at times. 

The ads and other advertisements are often in popups. That, to me, is the most distracting of the ads. We're those placed on thenpafes of the news app, it would be less distracting. 

Eventually, and unfortunately, I couldn't take it anymore. I deleted the app and went back to Apple News+, which is way more readable. 

I understand that it is a paid app, but Google could do a better job in ad placement.

reviews.text: Constant “Error displaying content” messages on any article longer than a couple of pages. On every iPhone I’ve owned. In every OS. I find it hard to believe that no one else sees this and still gives this PoS a positive review.

reviews.title: Filtering features
reviews.text: I run into way too many articles requiring subscriptions to read.  The fact that this app doesn’t allow me to filter by which articles don’t require a subscription has led me to stop using this app.

reviews.title: Full of glitches, bad design, low quality content
reviews.text:
Get used to seeing a page-killing “there was a problem displaying this content” modal an awful lot. I’ve read it’s to do with ads embedded in the articles, but viewing these same articles in Safari outside the Google News container doesn’t just nuke the entire page irreversibly, so there’s something going on with the wrapper Google News puts around the content.

I understand that a lot of content is paywalled and there’s not much that can be done about that, but the login/subscribe modals on these articles shouldn’t completely override the ability to close the pages out or go back to the main article list view. When this happens, often the only solution is to force quit Google News entirely. This has been this way for, I don’t know, over a decade now. Very annoying.

reviews.title: Sponsored to pay
reviews.text: Heavily sponsored by pay per read news sites so that’s 90% of what you’ll get. The other 10% so heavy with ads can’t find the article to read so u just close and move on.

reviews.title: Another lazy Google app
reviews.text: This app has issues that Google has ignored for years. You are better off using Apple News or any other news aggregator.

reviews.title: App Constantly Crashes

reviews.title: Constantly Crashing
reviews.text: Great app for discovering articles but every time you try to read an article, you get error messages after a few seconds. Unusable if you actually want to read anything.

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text:
The same story is on for days, and the app crashes constantly while trying to read the new ones.  Really only good for getting the headlines. 

I’m updating my review now.  The app doesn’t crash as often as it used too now. But now it’s become a site where all the news providers go to fish for subscribers. CNN, FOX, most of the big names as well.  No longer worth having on my phone.

reviews.title: Crash News

Every time I try to use the app stories will crash and need to be reloaded, and many times the constant ads block the article. 
This is the worst news app I’ve used, I can’t see what all the 5 stars are for, unless Google is paying for them. 
Shockingly bad app from a supposed titan.

I want to see articles from reliable news sources that present what’s happening with their commentary including reactions from people impacted or commentary from those who witnessed the event. reviews.title: Old news and too much propaganda
reviews.text:
First off, lately half the news in my feed is some White House (or other .gov)  propaganda. Many have headlines in all caps.  There’s no way to filter them either. 

But pandering and gaslighting aside, what’s more aggravating for me is that many of the other articles in my feed are simply -old- news. Like some are several days to a week old! And refreshing does nothing.  I have another news aggregation app in which articles are updating constantly and I’m able to follow breaking news stories. 

You’d think with the vast resources of Alphabet/ Google they could put together a better news app… but here we are
